description: This file defines a React component for drag-and-drop functionality within a dashboard interface, utilizing react-dnd. It includes styling, state management, and integration with react-dnd's drag source and drop target HOCs.

classes.name: UnwrappedDragDroppable
classes.description: A React PureComponent implementing drag-and-drop behavior with react-dnd, managing drag state, refs, and rendering children with appropriate props.

methods.name: setRef
methods.description: Sets the ref for the component and manages drag preview setup.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to drag state and triggers callbacks for indicator changes and drag tab updates.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the styled div with children, applying drag-and-drop styles and indicators.
